affected_subject.reason: HypoVault constructor and its totalSupply/share formulas are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Constructor sets totalSupply with 1,000,000 ghost shares never minted to any account.

direct_effect.reason: Deposits over-mint and withdrawals under-pay due to inflated totalSupply denominator.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Explicit ERC-20 invariant totalSupply == sum(balanceOf[]) is stated as violated.

summary: Report identifies HypoVault constructor creating unbacked ghost shares, violating the stated totalSupply==sum(balanceOf) invariant, causing over-minting on deposits and under-payment on withdrawals.
